lung adenocarcinoma: A high-resolution lung tumor slide showing adenocarcinoma with cohesive cuboidal or columnar malignant epithelial cells forming glands or acini, intracellular or extracellular mucin, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, and prominent nucleoli.

A low-resolution lung tumor slide showing adenocarcinoma with peripheral gland-forming tumor, acinar, papillary, lepidic, micropapillary, or solid architecture, mucin production, and heterogeneous desmoplastic stroma.
malignant epithelial cells with glandular differentiation or mucin production
peripheral gland-forming, acinar, papillary, micropapillary, solid, or lepidic tumor architecture
lung squamous cell carcinoma: A high-resolution lung tumor slide showing squamous cell carcinoma with polygonal malignant cells, dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, intercellular bridges, dyskeratosis, keratin pearls, nuclear pleomorphism, and frequent mitoses.

A low-resolution lung tumor slide showing squamous cell carcinoma with central or proximal solid tumor nests, sheets and lobules, pushing or infiltrative borders, stromal desmoplasia, and geographic keratinization or necrosis.
polygonal malignant cells with intercellular bridges, dyskeratosis, or keratin pearls
solid squamous nests and sheets with necrosis or keratinization
